caption: The drawing depicts two detailed views of a sword with a scabbard. The top portion shows the full length of the sword encased in a dark, curved scabbard that appears to be brown or black, with a metallic sheen. Metal fittings are visible on the scabbard, including two rings for attaching to a belt. The hilt of the sword is exposed and is colored in shades of bronze and gold, with a grip wrapped in a brownish material. The bottom portion of the drawing provides a close-up view of the sword's hilt, emphasizing the guard with its sweeping, curved bars and the coiled grip. The handguard and pommel are metallic, matching the bronze and gold tones, and the grip appears textured and wrapped. There is handwritten text underneath the close-up indicating "Colt. Beerenniiss." The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color.
title: Sabre
